scheduled_announcements.name: daily_reminder
scheduled_announcements.message: ⚔️ **Daily Reminder** — Collect daily rewards, train troops, check alliance gifts, and complete daily missions!

scheduled_announcements.name: weekly_tips
scheduled_announcements.message: 📖 **Weekly Tip** — Optimize your survivor roles! Reassign workers based on what you're building this week. Share your setups below!

scheduled_announcements.name: strongest_governor_start
scheduled_announcements.message:
👑 **Strongest Governor Starts Today!** (7-day event)

📋 **Daily Schedule:**
Day 1: City Construction
Day 2: Hero Development
Day 3: Basic Skills Up
Day 4: Combat Training
Day 5: Basic Skills Up
Day 6: Combat Training
Day 7: Hero Development

⏰ Daily reset at 00:00 UTC. Hoard speedups & resources beforehand!
Use `/event strongest_governor` for the full guide.
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable when SG week starts — occurs monthly (Week 1 of 4-week cycle)

scheduled_announcements.name: strongest_governor_daily
scheduled_announcements.message: 👑 **Strongest Governor** — New daily stage resets at 00:00 UTC! Push your points before the day ends. Check today's task focus and plan accordingly.
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable during SG week only

scheduled_announcements.name: alliance_brawl_start
scheduled_announcements.message:
💥 **Alliance Brawl Starts Today!** (7-day event)

📋 **Daily Stages & Horn Values:**
Day 1: Rise of the City (1 horn)
Day 2: Hero Development (2 horns)
Day 3: Pet Training (2 horns)
Day 4: Gear Enhancement (2 horns)
Day 5: Trade Baron (2 horns)
Day 6: Full-Scale Competition (4 horns!) ← DECISIVE DAY

⚠️ Day 6 alone can decide the entire Brawl! Save your best push for it.
Use `/event alliance_brawl` for the full guide.
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable when Brawl week starts — occurs monthly (Week 2 of 4-week cycle)

scheduled_announcements.name: alliance_brawl_daily
scheduled_announcements.message: 💥 **Alliance Brawl** — New stage today! Check the current challenge and coordinate with your team. Push hard!
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable during Brawl week only

scheduled_announcements.name: alliance_brawl_finale
scheduled_announcements.message:
🔥🔥🔥 **ALLIANCE BRAWL DAY 6 — FINALE!** 🔥🔥🔥

This is worth **4 HORNS** — more than any other day! This can decide the entire Brawl.

⚡ **GO ALL OUT** — use your best speedups, resources, and boosts NOW!
Coordinate in voice chat. Every point counts!
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable on Brawl Day 6 (Saturday of Brawl week)

scheduled_announcements.name: swordland_showdown_voting
scheduled_announcements.message:
⚔️ **Swordland Showdown — Voting Phase Started!** (2 days)

Alliance members: vote for your preferred battle time NOW!
Officers will register based on the most popular time slot.

📅 Schedule: Voting (2d) → Registration (2d) → Matchmaking (2d) → Battle (1hr)
Use `/event swordland_showdown` for the full guide.
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable when SLS voting starts — occurs bi-weekly (every 14 days)

scheduled_announcements.name: swordland_showdown_battle
scheduled_announcements.message:
⚔️ **SWORDLAND SHOWDOWN BATTLE TODAY!** (1 hour)

🏰 Rush priority: Stables → Swordshrine → Sanctums
🛡️ Losses on the battlefield do NOT affect your city troops!

Be online and ready. Coordinate rally leaders in voice chat!
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable on SLS battle day — adjust time to match your alliance vote

scheduled_announcements.name: all_out_kill_event
scheduled_announcements.message:
💀 **ALL OUT (Kill Event) Starts Today!** (2 days)

⚠️ **SHIELD UP if you're not participating!**

Kill points from enemy troops earn individual & alliance rewards.
Coordinate rallies, flag targets, and stay in comms!
Use `/event all_out` for hero/troop recommendations.
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable on KE week — occurs in Week 4 of cycle

scheduled_announcements.name: kvk_matchmaking
scheduled_announcements.message:
🌍 **Kingdom of Power (KvK) — Matchmaking Started!** (2 days)

📅 **Phase Schedule:**
Matchmaking: Sat-Sun
Preparation: 5 days (scout enemy kingdoms!)
Battle: 12 hours (borders open 10:00-22:00 UTC, castle siege at 12:00 UTC)

Start prepping NOW — heal troops, stock resources, coordinate with kingdom chat!
Use `/event kvk` for the full guide.
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable when KvK matchmaking begins — occurs every 4 weeks

scheduled_announcements.name: kvk_battle_day
scheduled_announcements.message:
🌍🔥 **KvK BATTLE DAY!** 🔥🌍

⏰ **Cross-Kingdom Borders Open: 10:00 UTC**
⏰ **Castle Siege Begins: 12:00 UTC**
⏰ **Borders Close: 22:00 UTC**

All hands on deck! Rally leaders get ready. This is what we've been prepping for!
scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable on KvK battle day ONLY — manually enable/disable

scheduled_announcements.name: sanctuary_battle
scheduled_announcements.message:
🏛️ **Sanctuary Battle Reminder!**

Check your alliance's voted battle time (options: 03:00, 09:00, 13:00, 14:00, or 17:00 UTC).
Make sure you're online and ready before it starts!

Use `/event sanctuary` for strategy tips.
scheduled_announcements.notes: Sanctuary battles happen on voted days — adjust cron as needed

scheduled_announcements.name: bear_hunt_reminder
scheduled_announcements.message:
🐻 **Bear Hunt (Pitfall) Available!**

The trap lasts 30 minutes — maximize alliance damage for better rewards!
Go full offense — the bear deals NO return damage.
Rally leaders: start the hunt when most members are online.

Use `/event bear_hunt` for the full guide.
scheduled_announcements.notes: Bear Hunt available every 2 days — adjust to your alliance schedule

scheduled_announcements.name: fishing_event
scheduled_announcements.message:

scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable during Fishing event weeks

scheduled_announcements.name: merchant_empire
scheduled_announcements.message:

scheduled_announcements.notes: Enable when Merchant Empire starts — runs concurrently with Brawl
